title: Market Participation: Buying and Selling at Grand Exchange: 1,000 cr each, once per pilot; ten copper ore bought and sold back there
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-23 00:15 UTC (orders.log ENT-068, P6: the newborns' starter missions on their own board; rule F34). Grand Exchange's board (data/missions, 23:46 UTC) offers Market Participation: Buying (buy 10 units of any item on the exchange) and Selling (sell 10 units of any item), 1,000 cr and 15 Trading XP each. Grand Exchange's book of 23:56 UTC: copper ore asked at 5 x 42,806, bid 2 x 2,730: ten units cost about 51 cr and bring about 20 back, for 2,000 cr once. The pattern of voidborn-selling (157 runs). A pilot holding neither mission and with both booked is not sent (skip_if_booked); a stop whose mission is closed is passed (only_if_active). The runner buys nothing under 3,000 cr (route_run FLOOR), so only the newborns above it fly it until their top-up (requests.log ENT-385). One ship first (F12: one unit of goods first is the runner's ask check; F37: one ship three times, the same seller and buyer). min_credits 3,200: the runner's buy floor of 3,000 and the 81 cr of ore (first run 00:20 UTC: a 250 cr pilot accepted both and bought nothing).
